Verify Now Blog > Meet PCBWay at PCB West 2026 in Santa Clara Meet PCBWay at PCB West 2026 in Santa Clara by: Mila Sep 23,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay is excited to announce its participation in PCB West 2026, taking place on September 30, 2026, at the Santa Clara Convention Center in California. Visitors are welcome to meet the PCBWay team at Booth 311 and explore our PCB and electronics manufacturing capabilities. Visit PCBWay at Booth 311 As one of the major events for the electronics design and manufacturing industry, PCB West brings together PCB designers, engineers, fabricators, assemblers, and other professionals from across the electronics supply chain. The 2026 conference runs from September 29 to October 2, with the exhibition taking place on September 30. Event: PCB West 2026 Date: September 30, 2026 Venue: Santa Clara Convention Center, Santa Clara, California Booth: 311 Explore PCB and Electronics Manufacturing Solutions PCB development often involves more than PCB fabrication alone. Design, component sourcing, assembly, testing, and manufacturing all need to work together to bring a project from concept to a finished product. At PCB West 2026, visitors can talk with the PCBWay team about solutions covering different stages of the development and manufacturing process, including: PCB fabrication and prototyping PCB assembly and component sourcing PCB design and layout Advanced and multilayer PCB manufacturing Electronics manufacturing solutions Our team can also discuss specific project requirements and help identify suitable manufacturing options based on your design, application, and production needs. Connect with PCBWay at PCB West 2026 PCB West has been bringing together professionals from the PCB design, fabrication, and assembly industries for more than 30 years. The 2026 event will feature more than 100 exhibiting companies and is expected to attract thousands of designers, engineers, fabricators, and assemblers. If you are attending PCB West 2026, stop by Booth 311 to meet the PCBWay team, see what we can offer, and discuss your next electronics project. Learn more about PCB West 2026. We look forward to seeing you at PCB West 2026! Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us.
